explication: QuickLook Video extends macOS media support: users see Finder thumbnails and Quick Look previews, and Spotlight supplies richer Finder metadata. The documented product has two Media Extensions for non-native formats and video codecs; the tree also exposes format reading, decoding, thumbnail/contact-sheet, and metadata components. The README establishes the platform integrations, but sampled source does not show all extension dispatch or call paths, so those internal links are marked unverified rather than presented as confirmed calls.
